picks.title: Sean Stone’s 10 Things to Learn: Ancient Wisdom for the Modern Soul
picks.summary: 10 Things to Learn: Ancient Wisdom for the Modern Soul explores what it means to remain fully human in an age increasingly defined by technology, optimization, and artificial intelligence. While modern civilization has expanded humanity’s power and capability, it has done little to eliminate suffering, grief, fear, or the search for meaning. This book argues that life’s deepest questions cannot be answered through efficiency or control. Instead, genuine growth emerges through a series of essential initiations—moments of collapse, surrender, loss, rest, and devotion that shape the soul. Blendin
picks.reason: Explores ancient wisdom addressing human suffering and meaning in modern life.

picks.showTitle: The Bible in a Year (with Fr. Mike Schmitz)
picks.title: Day 261: Ornate Souls (2026)
picks.summary:
Fr. Mike explains the many parables we hear today in Matthew, including the return of the unclean spirit, and the danger of ornate souls. He emphasizes that when God sweeps the sin out of our souls, we must replace it with virtue, otherwise our souls remain empty without a relationship with God. Today's readings are Matthew 11-13 and Proverbs 19:5-8.

For the complete reading plan, visit ascensionpress.com/bibleinayear.

Please note: The Bible contains adult themes that may not be suitable for children - parental discretion is advised.]]>
picks.reason: Catholic priest explains parables about sin, virtue, and spiritual emptiness.

picks.title: How God Turns You Into a Man
picks.summary: Through Moses’ story, we see how faith, marriage, fatherhood, hard work, and sacrifice can transform a floundering man into a protector, provider, and godly leader.
picks.reason: Discusses transformation through faith and life roles but mainly practical and narrative.
